proof.criterion: The deploy key appears only in the env of the steps that push, through `release-push.sh push-tag` and `push-main`, which reach GitHub over SSH with the key in a directory of their own, removed when the script exits (Done when, bullet 3; the fix, bullet 4).
proof.surface: A bare origin at /tmp/pt/work/origin.git with a pre-receive hook recording GIT_SSH_COMMAND, the key's mode and owner, its directory's mode and the real `ssh -G github.com` resolution of the command; a throwaway ed25519 key as DEPLOY_KEY; `url./tmp/pt/work/origin.git.insteadOf=git@github.com:example/repo.git` so the push to the script's own SSH URL lands locally; TMPDIR private to the rig; plus a real `ssh -T git@github.com` under the script's pinned known_hosts.
proof.command: bash /tmp/pt/rig.sh; ssh -F /dev/null -o UserKnownHostsFile=<the script's 3 pinned keys> -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -T git@github.com; diff <(gh api meta --jq '.ssh_keys[]' | sort) <(pinned keys)
proof.observed: push-tag: hook saw `key: 600 legion dir: 700 known_hosts: 600`, the key file's first line is the OpenSSH header, `ssh -G`: batchmode yes, identitiesonly yes, stricthostkeychecking true, identityfile <dir>/key, globalknownhostsfile /dev/null, userknownhostsfile <dir>/known_hosts; the tag landed; the key dir was gone afterwards and TMPDIR empty. Rejected by the hook: rc 1, dir gone, no tag on origin. push-main: a detached-HEAD bump fast-forwards main (1 hook invocation); main moved by a foreign commit → rebase, second push lands; a same-manifest race → `Resolving the packages/pkg/package.json version-line conflict to v1.0.4`, lands with main's manifest at 1.0.4; main already at 1.0.4 when pushing 1.0.2 → `::notice title=Version bump not pushed::… superseded`, exit 0; 5 rejections → rc 1, 5 hook invocations, `::error::` and the `**Version bump for packages/pkg v2.0.0 did not land on main.**` summary line, key dir gone. The pinned host keys are byte-identical to `gh api meta`'s three; the real ssh under them answers `git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).` (host key verified, auth refused as expected with no key). The private key's text appears in no output.
proof.negativeControl: `push-tag pkg-v1.0.1` with DEPLOY_KEY unset, and with `DEPLOY_KEY=` (empty), exits 1 at `DEPLOY_KEY holds the deploy key to reach GitHub with` before the hook runs and with nothing made under TMPDIR; GITHUB_REPOSITORY unset exits 1 the same way; a tag that does not exist locally fails the push with the dir removed.

proof.negativeControl: The five bypasses recorded in `failures` (npm ci/install/exec, an interpreter over a scripts/ program, a shell: python step, secrets['DEPLOY_KEY'], no permissions block anywhere) each leave the checker green on a copy of the real workflows; pinned red.

notes: The merge will cut a listener release: at main b5761883 and the head, `release-push.sh version legion-envoy-v …` gives 13.4.1 (6aeee579d's fix(dispatch) touched packages/envoy after legion-envoy-v13.4.0), so the first merge-triggered release-envoy-listener.yaml run is a release-cutting run (release_build stamps 13.4.1, release_publish confirms with --expect, tags, attests, releases) — the production check can record the listener's full path on that run, and `imagetools create` without setup-buildx-action is exercised there.

Hardening, not pinned: `no-credential`'s `find ~/.ssh -mindepth 1` does not descend when `~/.ssh` is a symlink to a directory (prints the listing, reports clean) and `[ -d ~/.ssh ]` reports a regular file as `absent`; both are sandbox-evasion shapes outside the tripwire's stated remit (`find -L` or a trailing slash closes the first). `Actions/Checkout@<sha>` (mis-cased owner/repo) in a build job skips rule 3 (`startswith('actions/checkout@')`); whether GitHub resolves that casing was not provable from this pod (the review App cannot write workflows to legion-smoke), so it is a note. `docker run <image>` in a credentialed job passes the checker (only `docker build`/`buildx build` are denied). `${{ toJSON(secrets) }}` or any `secrets.*` beyond GITHUB_TOKEN in a build job is not read as a credential; the red case covers only the DEPLOY_KEY index form.

Environment: PyYAML (a uv venv), jq 1.7 and openssh-client 10.0 were installed under $HOME/.local for the local runs; the pod image has none of them (the implement handoff recorded the same for its container). The `jq` builtin of the harness shell is jaq; the scripts ran under bash with the real jq first on PATH.

Tests not re-run: lint, typecheck and the unit suites are CI's (cited above); `go version -m` on a cross-built agent-secrets binary and `agent-secrets --version` were not re-measured here (planner's measurement in plan.json specDepartures; first executed on the merge-triggered listener run).
